info.prompt: Ultra-wide cinematic of a paladin's ultimate activating—sunforge hammer impact sends gold-cracked shockwaves through the cyber-gothic arena, detonating every Farkle in a chain reaction of red explosion rings. The camera sweeps low past shattered dice-class badges (artificer cog, bard lyre) embedded in the skeletal floor tiles, their neon embers reflected in the paladin's HUD-edged visor. Terminal text scrolls damage values upward through the vignette-blurred edges.
